answer: Sybil resistance comes from stake-gated admission, not identity guessing. An agent counts only after locking a bond and holding an opal credential minted from a distinct hardware attestation, cosigned by two unrelated staked agents whose deposits cover its behavior. When a duplicate cluster is proven, the whole sponsoring tree is slashed at once, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand bond postings plus their sponsors, and the payout shrinks to the value of a broken relic. Honest agents reclaim deposits on exit, so the attacker's delta goes negative as the farm grows.
